product: MM-ART-010 Berlin permanent one-off city-map wall relief with two display modes

scope.intended_use: Unique indoor decorative Berlin wall relief, produced as two four-color main prints and permanently assembled without adhesive, rear grid, magnets, or replaceable sections. Revision 0.4.0 supports either an irregular Berlin-boundary silhouette inside a maximum 600 x 400 mm envelope or a rectangular 600 x 400 mm Umland field with Berlin marked.
scope.user_context: Adult indoor customer; optional customer-supplied low-power rear halo/front-through lighting; production on the Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Combo.
out_of_scope: Wall anchors, electrical equipment, outdoor use, navigation claims, repeated disassembly, and universal load rating

entities.name: Three concealed one-way loose connector springs
Local snap-in hanger and standoff set

assembly.direction: Connector inserted into the first seam-edge pocket, then the halves are pressed together in panel X.
assembly.contact_mode: Three loose one-way spring/tenon connectors plus discrete seam locating lands.
assembly.sequence_notes: One assembly cycle; removal is not a service requirement and may be destructive.

evidence.uncertainty_note: Connector topology and lifecycle intent are inherited from 0.3.0, but the irregular perimeter can move or remove local lands; exact mode-specific placement, dimensions, clearance, retention and warp response require approved decomposition, CAD and a process-matched coupon.

failure_modes.mode: Connector is too tight, too loose, fractures, or permits a seam step
failure_modes.effect: Assembly failure, damaged one-off panel, visible discontinuity, or separation during handling
failure_modes.mitigation: Parametric multi-clearance coupon, in-plane spring orientation, three distributed connectors, and assembled handling/proof test

acceptance_criteria: At least one coupon variant assembles once without crack or whitening, holds the two seam strips flush, and resists the defined pull/step checks.

interfaces.name: Local hanger and standoffs support the artwork at the wall

loads_and_performance.load: assembled artwork self-weight; exact mass and proof factor unknown until CAD/slicer evidence
loads_and_performance.load_path: each main half receives its own upper support so the center seam is not the primary gravity path

evidence.uncertainty_note: Wall substrate, anchors, exact variant mass, silhouette-dependent hanger lands, connector geometry and physical proof result are unknown.

failure_modes.mode: Hanger, snap socket, anchor, or substrate fails
failure_modes.effect: Artwork falls and may cause injury or property damage
failure_modes.mitigation: Exclude universal anchors, provide independent support per half, qualify the printed interface, and require substrate-appropriate installation

acceptance_criteria: The complete printed hanger/standoff system survives the documented mass-based proof load without crack, disengagement, or permanent set; wall-anchor selection remains installer controlled.

interfaces.name: Optional customer LED system remains inside open rear keep-outs

evidence.uncertainty_note: The customer LED product, power, temperature, adhesive and wiring remain unknown and outside the product claim.

failure_modes.mode: Oversized or hot lighting conflicts with printed parts or overheats the open cavity
failure_modes.effect: Poor lighting, softened plastic, wiring damage, or fire risk from customer equipment
failure_modes.mitigation: Mechanical preparation only, open ventilation, declared generic envelope, and no electrical compatibility or safety claim

acceptance_criteria: A passive envelope gauge passes through all declared routes and the unlit artwork remains fully functional.

interfaces.owner: Customer for electrical system; MM-ART-010 for passive keep-outs

drivers: Two display modes with different outer topology and source extents
Fit-sensitive concealed one-way seam and snap-in mount interfaces
Coupling of global map/color registration with the permanent center seam and light openings
Four-color large-format manufacturing plus coupon, proof-load and appearance verification

blocking_unknowns: Human approval of the two-mode concept
Mode-aware seam, hanger and lighting-land placement for the irregular boundary
Immutable Berlin/Brandenburg source coverage for context_outline
Exact connector and snap clearances for the selected filament/profile
Exact filament products, batches, conditioning and Anycubic profiles
As-built mass, wall-anchor/substrate selection and physical proof-load result

criticality.rationale: The artwork is decorative, but a failed printed wall interface or unsuitable customer lighting has credible injury, property-damage, or heat consequences and therefore requires controlled tests.

decision.rationale: Proceed only through human approval of concept v03, then update decomposition and source coverage before mode-aware CAD. Production/release remains blocked until exact profiles, connector fit, assembled load behavior and human appearance review are evidenced.

warnings.message: The one-way connector and snap-in mounting interfaces have no exact process-qualified clearance or physical result.
Concealed seam pockets must remain printable in the face-up main-part orientation and must not create unsupported roofs or visible read-through.
Test methods are selected, but numeric pull, step, insertion-force and proof-load thresholds must be fixed after mass and coupon geometry exist.
The boundary_crop silhouette can remove or weaken revision 0.3.0 rear interface lands; both modes need a new interface-placement audit.
The frozen Berlin-only extract does not cover the default 12 percent context margin and cannot authorize a production context_outline build.

next_actions.action: Approve concept v03 showing boundary_crop and context_outline.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Human concept approval references revision 0.4.0 and concepts/berlin-display-modes-concept-v03.png.

next_actions.action: Update the decomposition for mode-owned outer masks, rear support lands, lighting paths and source ownership.
next_actions.exit_criterion: A reviewed 0.4.0 decomposition covers both modes without relying on removed geometry.

next_actions.action: Freeze an expanded Berlin/Brandenburg source and prove it covers the selected context bounds.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The immutable source and derived layers fully cover the 12 percent default context extent with recorded hashes.

next_actions.action: Revalidate connector, hanger and lighting interfaces before full panel CAD.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Mode-specific digital audits and process-matched coupons meet the controlled acceptance criteria.
